title: Diplomatic Refusal & Disagreement
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Decir 'no' o discrepar en los niveles más altos requiere sutileza. Usar expresiones como 'With all due respect' o 'I beg to differ' te permite mantener tu postura firme sin dañar la relación profesional.

parts.visual:
1. With all due respect (Con el debido respeto): 
- Se usa antes de contradecir a alguien, especialmente a un superior. 
Ej: With all due respect, I believe this strategy is flawed. 

2. I beg to differ (Me permito disentir / Difiero): 
- Una forma muy formal y firme de decir 'I disagree'. 
Ej: You think the market is shrinking, but I beg to differ. 

3. I have my reservations (Tengo mis reservas/dudas): 
- Una forma suave de decir que no confías en un plan. 
Ej: I have my reservations about the new vendor's reliability.
parts.audio: Welcome to Diplomatic Refusal. Saying 'no' or disagreeing at the highest levels requires subtlety. Number 1: With all due respect. Use this before contradicting someone, especially a superior. For example: With all due respect, I believe this strategy is flawed. Number 2: I beg to differ. This is a very formal and firm way of saying 'I disagree'. For example: You think the market is shrinking, but I beg to differ. Number 3: I have my reservations. A polite way to express doubt or lack of trust. For example: I have my reservations about the new vendor's reliability.

parts.visual:
4. I'm afraid that's out of the question (Me temo que eso está fuera de discusión): 
- Un 'NO' absoluto y definitivo, pero dicho de manera formal. 
Ej: Giving you a 50% discount is completely out of the question. 

5. Let's agree to disagree (Acordemos estar en desacuerdo): 
- Se usa para terminar una discusión sin ganadores cuando nadie cede. 
Ej: We are not making progress, so let's agree to disagree. 

6. I'd rather not (Preferiría no hacerlo): 
- Una forma suave pero clara de rechazar una solicitud. 
Ej: I'd rather not commit to a date just yet.
parts.audio: Number 4: I'm afraid that's out of the question. This is an absolute 'NO', but stated formally. For example: Giving you a fifty percent discount is completely out of the question. Number 5: Let's agree to disagree. Use this to end an argument when neither side will compromise. For example: We are not making progress, so let's agree to disagree. Number 6: I'd rather not. A gentle but clear way to decline a request. For example: I'd rather not commit to a date just yet.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la expresión diplomática adecuada para el contexto.

questions.question: ____ all due respect, sir, I don't think firing him is the right move.
questions.explanation: With all due respect = con el debido respeto.

questions.question: The CEO thinks this will increase sales, but I ____ to differ. (Disiento).
questions.explanation: I beg to differ = me permito disentir.

questions.question: I understand your enthusiasm, but I have my ____ about the viability of this project. (Reservas/Dudas).
questions.explanation: I have my reservations = tengo mis dudas/reservas.

questions.question: Approving a $5 million budget without seeing a business plan is completely out of the ____. (Fuera de discusión).
questions.explanation: Out of the question = imposible / fuera de discusión.

questions.question: Since neither of us will change our minds, let's agree to ____. (Estar en desacuerdo).
I'd ____ not discuss this matter in front of the client. (Preferiría no hacerlo).
questions.explanation: I'd rather not = preferiría no hacerlo.

questions.question: I'm not entirely ____ that this is the best approach. (Convencido).
questions.explanation: I'm not entirely convinced = no estoy del todo convencido.

questions.question: That's a valid point, but looking at it from another ____, we might lose money. (Perspectiva).
I'm ____ I can't agree with you on that. (Me temo que).
I see where you're coming ____, but we still have a budget deficit. (Entiendo tu postura).
questions.explanation: I see where you're coming from = entiendo tu punto de vista / de dónde vienes.

questions.question: That is simply not ____ at this moment in time. (Factible / Viable).
To be perfectly ____, I don't think your team is ready for this responsibility. (Franco/Honesto).
questions.explanation: To be perfectly frank = para ser perfectamente franco.

questions.question: I must take ____ with your claim that our quality has dropped. (Discrepar / No estar de acuerdo con una afirmación).
questions.explanation: Take issue with = estar en desacuerdo con / objetar algo.

questions.question: I think we are looking at this from completely different ____. (Ángulos).
questions.explanation: Different angles = diferentes ángulos o perspectivas.

questions.question: While I appreciate your ____, I'm afraid we have to decline. (Oferta/Aporte).
It's highly ____ that the board will approve such a massive expense. (Improbable).
I'm sorry, but my hands are ____ on this matter. (Atadas - no puedo hacer nada).
questions.explanation: My hands are tied = tengo las manos atadas (estoy limitado por reglas o superiores).

questions.question: I find that very hard to ____ given our current financial data. (Creer/Aceptar).
questions.explanation: Hard to swallow = difícil de tragar/creer/aceptar.

questions.question: I'm inclined to ____ with John on this particular issue. (Estar de acuerdo - disentir del otro).
questions.explanation: Inclined to agree = inclinado a estar de acuerdo.

questions.question: That goes against company ____, so we cannot proceed. (Política).
questions.explanation: Company policy = política de la empresa.
